newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant sees two-digit 1996 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Clariant sees two-digit 1996 profit rise.

text.p: Clariant Ltd said on Wednesday it expected sales to remain strong in the fourth quarter and confirmed its earlier forecast of double-digit net profit growth for all of 1996.
"We expect positive sales developments to continue in the fourth quarter," it said.
Clariant reported group sales rose five percent in the first nine months to 1.723 billion Swiss francs.
"Despite price pressure on textile dyes and strong competition in pigments, we still expect double-digit growth in group profit in 1996," it said in a statement.
Clariant posted a 1995 net profit of 106 million francs.
It said sales rose five percent measured in Swiss francs and four percent in local currencies in the first nine months.
"This pleasant development is the result of clear sales growth in the third quarter, in which September had the best sales performance," it said. "All business lines contributed to the improvement."
Even the textile dyes division had caught up to last year's level after having lagged in recent months, it said.
